notes.title: Demo patch is out now! Follow us on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for the positive reviews and Wishlists! Patch notes for the demo below.


⦁	Fixed creatures not following on stairs.
⦁	Reduced camera shake. Option to disable will come later.
⦁	You can now change weapons without unequipping, this will be done automatically now when you drop a new weapon on the slot.
⦁	Sped up get up recovery time from dragon hits.
⦁	Enemies rotate towards player during attack animation making it harder to just walk around them.
⦁	Buffed Ogre.
⦁	Two-Handed weapons now grey out the secondary slot when equipped.
⦁	Intro screens and loading screens added.
⦁	Escape key works during in game menu now.
⦁	Skills have been added to skill slots at start.
⦁	Improved performance in the Fire trap area.
⦁	Fixed some animations and weapon socket locations.
⦁	Fixed a number of collision issues with the environment.


Follow us on our Kickstarter pre-launch page to be notified when it launches!
